title: Nut-Breaker
summary: NUT-BREAKER. [See Nutcracker.] NUT'-BROWN, adjective Brown as a nut long kept and dried. NUT'-CRACKER, noun 1. An instrument for cracking nuts. 2. A bird of the genus Corvus; the nut-breaker
